variables.name: Food CPI (National)
variables.definition: National Consumer Price Index, group 1 'Food & non-alcoholic beverages' (weight 34.58%)
variables.transform: Natural log. Monthly and year-on-year % changes for description.
variables.rebasing: From 2019M07 the series is PBS's 2015-16-base national CPI (identical to PBS Table 1, verified to ±0.003 index points). Earlier months are the IMF's back-linked series, which chains the previous (2007-08-base) CPI onto the new base; its FY2015-16 average is 101.6 rather than 100. The linkage is documented and tested with a 2019M07 step dummy and a post-2019M07 sub-sample.

variables.name: Exchange rate, PKR per USD
variables.definition: Official exchange rate, Pakistani rupees per US dollar, monthly period average
variables.transform: Natural log; a rise is a DEPRECIATION of the rupee.
variables.rebasing: None. Cross-checked against IMF IFS ENDA_XDC_USD_RATE (2015M01–2025M06): correlation 0.99997.

variables.name: Cumulative depreciation (EXR⁺)
variables.definition: Partial sum of positive monthly changes in ln(EXR) since 2015M01

variables.name: Cumulative appreciation (EXR⁻)
variables.definition: Partial sum of negative monthly changes in ln(EXR) since 2015M01 (≤ 0)

variables.name: International food prices
variables.definition: FAO Food Price Index (nominal, US dollar based)

variables.name: Domestic energy cost: Transport CPI
variables.definition: National CPI group 7 'Transport' (weight 5.91%), dominated by motor fuel; captures domestic petrol/diesel prices and freight-related fares that feed food distribution costs

variables.name: Housing, water, electricity, gas & fuels CPI
Brent crude oil price
variables.definition: Crude oil, Brent, US dollars per barrel

variables.name: World Bank food price index
variables.definition: Pink Sheet food price index, nominal US dollars

considered_but_excluded.reason: SBP's statistics portal refused automated access (HTTP 403) and the IMF IFS policy-rate series is not in the mirror; monetary policy works mainly through the exchange rate and demand, whose effect on food prices is partly captured by EXR.
IMF IFS FMB_XDC ends in 2025M04 (8 missing months); adding it would shorten the common sample.
Brent (USD) substitutes for the domestic energy proxy in a robustness model.
No consistent monthly official series for 2015–2025 was obtainable; event dummies for the 2022 floods are tested instead.
